why: The general problem remains open (Wikipedia's article still says no combinatorial description is known), but arXiv 2511.02312 (Nov 2025/2026) gives an explicit positive combinatorial interpretation via marked trees for the rectangular Kronecker coefficients g(lambda,(n^k),(n^k)) when lambda has at most two rows, a settled special case of the stated problem.
